# Turf reward from ASSS 1.4.4 src/turf/turf_reward.c plus the scoring module
# src/turf/points_turf_reward.c, both compiled unmodified.
#
# A replayable transcript. '# <label>' starts a scenario; the 'settings' line that
# follows is what loadSettings() resolved from the arena config (its clamps and its
# weight defaulting already applied), so a reimplementation can start from there and
# does not have to model the config parser.
#
#   settings style=<RewardStyle 0..5> modifier maxpoints minplayersteam
#            minplayersarena minteams minflags minpctflags minweights minpctweights
#            minpct spec safe weightcalc recovery recoverdings recovertime
#            recovermax timerinitial timerinterval flags=<turf flags on the map>
#            weights=<comma-separated weight table>
#     RewardStyle: 0 DISABLED 1 PERIODIC 2 STANDARD 3 STD_BTY 4 WEIGHTS 5 FIXED_PTS
#     weightcalc:  0 DINGS 1 TIME.  recovery: 0 DINGS 1 TIME 2 DINGS_AND_TIME
#   seat <triples>         one triple per player, in player order: freq digit, then
#                          'w' in a ship or 's' in spec, then '.' normal, 'z' in a
#                          safe zone, or 'e' not yet S_PLAYING (still entering).
#   tag <flag> <player>    ran the CB_TURFTAG handler for that player's current freq
#   kill <killer> <killed> <bounty>   ran the CB_KILL handler
#   advance <ticks>        moved the clock on (1 tick = 10 ms; 6000 = one minute)
#   ding                   ran the reward sequence the module's timer runs
#   arena <blocked> <numPlayers> <numValidPlayers> <numTeams> <numValidTeams>
#         <numInvalidTeams> <numWeights> <sumPerCapitaFlags> <sumPerCapitaWeights>
#         <numPoints> <tags> <steals> <recoveries> <lost> <kills> <bountyExchanged>
#         blocked=1 means checkArenaRequirements failed, so no scoring ran at all.
#   calc <status> <award> <update>   the TurfState the scoring module left behind.
#         status: 0 SUCCESS 1 FAIL.  award: 0 PLAYER 1 TEAM 2 BOTH 3 NONE.
#   team <freq> <valid> <numFlags> <numPlayers> <numWeights> <percentFlags>
#        <percentWeights> <perCapitaFlags> <perCapitaWeights> <percent> <numPoints>
#        in ta->teams order (newest first, since teams are pushed on the front).
#   validorder <freq>...   the validTeams list in order AFTER scoring, which matters
#        because TR_STYLE_FIXED_PTS sorts it and then pays out by position.
#   ppoints <name>:<freq>:<points>...   per-player points the scoring module set.
#   award <player>:<points>...  what each player's STAT_FLAG_POINTS actually moved by.
#   chat <player|arena> <sound|-> <text>  every message emitted during the step.
#   flags <id>:<freq|->/<tagger>/<dings>/<weight>/<recovered>[/old:<freq>,<lastOwned>,
#         <dings>,<weight>,<recovered>]...   flag state after the ding, including each
#         previous owner still holding a chance to recover.
# Doubles are printed with %.17g, so they round-trip exactly through IEEE-754.
#
# The things these records are here to pin, in the order they bite:
#
# 1. perCapitaFlags and perCapitaWeights are INTEGER divisions. preCalc computes
#    'pTeam->numFlags / pTeam->numPlayers' and 'pTeam->numWeights / pTeam->numPlayers'
#    in int/long arithmetic and only then assigns the result to a double. Seven
#    weights across three players is 2, not 2.333..., and sumPerCapitaWeights is a sum
#    of those truncated values. Every percentage downstream inherits the truncation.
#    A port that divides in floating point produces plausible, wrong numbers here;
#    the scenario labelled 'integer per-capita' exists only to catch that.
# 2. percentWeights IS a true double ratio (numWeights/arena numWeights*100), so the
#    module mixes truncated and untruncated ratios in the same calculation.
# 3. percentFlags is NOT recomputed by preCalc. It is only ever written by flagTag,
#    for the two teams involved in that tag, so it can be stale by the time MinFlags
#    Percent is tested against it.
# 4. A team's share is 'numPoints * (percent/100) / numPlayers' truncated to int, with
#    numPoints an unsigned long and percent a double, and that per-team figure is what
#    each of its players receives -- it is not divided again.
# 5. crPeriodic calls crStandard first and then overrides it. crStandard's failure
#    paths 'return' out of crStandard, NOT out of crPeriodic, so crPeriodic carries on
#    regardless and always finishes at CALC_REWARD_SUCCESS. With RewardModifier 0 it
#    even sets award=NONE and then immediately overwrites that with award=TEAM on the
#    way out, so 'dings disabled' still awards -- zero points, but through the award
#    path, and it still updates flags.
# 6. TR_STYLE_FIXED_PTS sorts validTeams with a comparator that is a strict less-than
#    on numPoints, and ASSS's LLSort is a stable merge sort, so the list comes out
#    ASCENDING -- the 1000 goes to the team the standard formula rated LOWEST. The
#    source carries a 'CHECK: I am unsure if LLSort sorts asc or desc' comment at that
#    exact line. Payouts are 1000, 500, then 0 for everyone after.
# 7. TR_STYLE_DISABLED makes calcReward return without touching calcState, so the
#    TR_CALC_FAIL that preCalc left there stands and doReward stops the ding timer.
#    An unrecognised style reaches CALC_REWARD_FAILED, which reports SUCCESS with
#    award NONE instead -- failure and 'disabled' are different states.
# 8. Recovery restores the flag's previous dings, weight and tagTC, and sets
#    recovered = previous + 1; it does not restore the previous tagger. The entry is
#    only consulted for the freq that lost it, entries expire by lastOwned >
#    RecoverDings and/or by (now - lostTC)/100 > RecoverTime depending on
#    RecoveryCutoff, and RecoverMax caps how many times one flag may be recovered --
#    by refusing to record a NEW previous-owner entry once pTF->recovered reaches it.
# 9. calcWeight clamps the index into the weight table: a negative index gives 0 (not
#    weights[0]), and anything past the end gives the last weight. A freshly tagged
#    flag has dings 0, so it is already worth weights[0] before its first ding.
#10. Teams are kept in a list that is pushed on the front, and preCalc drops any team
#    with no players and no flags before counting. Players keep a node per team they
#    played on, and postRewardCleanup drops the inactive ones that hold no flags.
#11. points_turf_reward's two state macros are not symmetric: CALC_REWARD_FAILED ends
#    in a 'return;' and CALC_REWARD_SUCCESS does not. So crStandard's 'no points to
#    award' branch, which uses the SUCCESS macro, is not an early exit at all -- it
#    sets the state and falls straight through into the payout loop, which fills in
#    every team's percent and then multiplies a pot of zero by it. The second ding of
#    the TR_STYLE_STD_BTY scenario is that case: numPoints 0, yet percent 50.
#12. Under TR_STYLE_WEIGHTS the arena's own numPoints is never set, because crWeights
#    does not call crStandard. Players are told 'Reward: <n>/0' -- the denominator in
#    that message is the pot, and for this style there isn't one.
#13. The reward message is chosen by comparing the awarded points against MaxPoints
#    for EQUALITY, so a player who happens to earn exactly MaxPoints without being
#    clamped still gets the ' [MAX] ' message (note its trailing space).
# integer per-capita: 7 weights over 3 players is 2, not 2.333
settings style=2 modifier=200 maxpoints=10000 minplayersteam=1 minplayersarena=1 minteams=1 minflags=1 minpctflags=0 minweights=1 minpctweights=0 minpct=0 spec=0 safe=0 weightcalc=0 recovery=0 recoverdings=1 recovertime=300 recovermax=-1 timerinitial=6000 timerinterval=6000 flags=12 weights=1
